name: Ford - Flat Rock Assembly Plant, Flat Rock MI

fieldNotes.facility: Flat Rock Assembly Plant (Ford Mustang - exclusive NA production site), 1 International Dr, Flat Rock MI. Roster geocode (moved 3258m) nonetheless landed centrally on the plant; confirmed as the large assembly complex - ~2.9M sq ft of building on a 400-acre site (web-confirmed).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Secured Ford assembly campus with continuous perimeter chain-link fencing visible in Street View. Controlled access driveway off the public road with a Ford-branded entrance; an internal gate/checkpoint structure with a guard booth and crosswalk markings controls movement between the perimeter storage lots and the inner yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Ford assembly plants run staffed security gatehouses; a booth structure is visible at the internal checkpoint. Marked uncertain - the perimeter truck-gate booth could not be crisply isolated; Street View panos sit on the campus loop road rather than directly at the public-road gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed gatehouse model is used.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Outer perimeter gate plus an internal vehicle-control checkpoint between the storage lots and the inner yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail infrastructure visible at the NW of the campus; assembly plant of this scale relies on rail. Rail yard adjacent to the complex.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very large dedicated trailer drop yards - hundreds of trailers in multiple organized rows along the NE side and additional rows on the west - among the largest trailer-parking footprints in the Ford roster.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers visible; the NE drop yard alone holds well over 100 trailers.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~220 trailers counted across the NE and west drop yards - approximate, high count.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~40 loading doors across building faces; estimate from overhead imagery - marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces serving the inbound trailer yards and outbound vehicle dispatch.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate aprons and multi-lane internal driveways with substantial unused paved width for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple large connected buildings forming an integrated assembly campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Flat Rock with farmland and open land adjacent to the campus - per rubric, when torn between small-town industrial and Urban, choose Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left uncertain.

citations.claim: 2026 Ford Mustang (S650) assembled at Flat Rock Assembly

verification.rationale: Ford-operated Mustang assembly, actively producing 2026 Mustang through 2028 MY.
